updates.title_zh: 【Webull 将于 11 月向美国用户开放永续合约交易，首批涵盖比特币等加密资产】
updates.title_en: 【Webull 将于 11 月向美国用户开放永续合约交易，首批涵盖比特币等加密资产】
updates.what_changed_zh:
在线投资平台 Webull（NASDAQ: BULL）将于 11 月起向符合条件的美国客户开放永续合约交易，首批产品包括比特币和其他加密资产，并计划在年底前扩大开放范围。该永续合约将在 CFTC 监管的指定合约市场 KalshiEX 挂牌，并由 CFTC 监管的衍生品清算机构 Kalshi Klear 负责清算，用户可通过现有 Webull 期货账户直接交易。

此次上线让已获批期货交易资格的美国零售客户可以通过 CFTC 监管的场所交易加密永续合约，而这一产品此前对美国用户主要在场外平台交易。初期仅面向已获批期货交易资格的客户开放。

Webull 表示，该业务将于 11 月启动，并计划在年底前扩大适用范围；交易通过现有的 Webull 期货账户进行，而非新设加密专属产品线。相关产品在 KalshiEX 挂牌，由 Kalshi Klear 清算。
updates.what_changed_en: Webull will begin offering CFTC-regulated crypto perpetual futures, initially including Bitcoin, to eligible US customers starting in November through its existing futures accounts, with KalshiEX listing and Kalshi Klear clearing the products.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Webull will begin offering CFTC-regulated crypto perpetual futures, initially including Bitcoin, to eligible US customers starting in November through its existing futures accounts, with KalshiEX listing and Kalshi Klear clearing the products.
updates.background_zh: 永续合约是没有到期日的期货合约，通过资金费率机制使合约价格贴近标的资产，这一产品起源于加密市场，目前在加密交易量中占比很大。KalshiEX LLC 于 2020 年 11 月获得 CFTC 的指定合约市场资格，Kalshi Klear LLC 则于 2024 年 8 月 28 日注册为衍生品清算机构，此后 Kalshi 开始通过该关联机构清算其合约。
updates.background_en: Perpetual futures are futures contracts without an expiration date that use a funding-rate mechanism to keep contract prices close to a reference asset; they originated in crypto markets and account for a large share of crypto trading activity. KalshiEX LLC received a CFTC order of designation as a designated contract market in November 2020, and Kalshi Klear LLC was registered as a derivatives clearing organization on August 28, 2024, after which Kalshi began clearing its contracts through the affiliate.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于交易场所与监管结构：一家美国券商通过 CFTC 监管的交易所与清算机构提供永续合约，为美国账户提供了场外永续合约平台之外的合规替代选择，可能使部分零售衍生品交易流转向美国境内，并加剧美国合规加密衍生品场所之间的竞争。由于初期仅面向已获批期货交易资格的账户，且标的资产范围有限，对永续合约整体流动性的影响可能是渐进的。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is venue and regulatory structure: a US brokerage offering perps through a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse gives US accounts a compliant alternative to offshore perpetual venues, potentially shifting some retail derivatives flow onshore and intensifying competition among regulated US crypto-derivatives venues. Because access is initially limited to futures-approved accounts and a narrow asset list, any effect on aggregate perpetual liquidity is likely incremental.
